class.name: AnimationTree
class.brief_description: A node used for advanced animation transitions in an [AnimationPlayer].
class.description: A node used for advanced animation transitions in an [AnimationPlayer]. [b]Note:[/b] When linked with an [AnimationPlayer], several properties and methods of the corresponding [AnimationPlayer] will not function as expected. Playback and transitions should be handled using only the [AnimationTree] and its constituent [AnimationNode](s). The [AnimationPlayer] node should be used solely for adding, deleting, and editing animations.

method.name: clear_blend_space_cycle_sync
method.description: Clears the cycle sync configuration and restores independent override parameters, initialized to the last shared duration. Must be called from the main thread.

method.name: configure_blend_space_cycle_sync
method.description: Configures one shared cycle duration for this tree. Targets must be [AnimationNodeBlendSpace1D] or [AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D] [code]cycle_duration_override[/code] parameter paths; sources must be [code]effective_cycle_duration[/code] parameter paths. Before each graph evaluation, the weighted mean of the sources' previous evaluation values becomes the shared override. Invalid source durations use the previous shared duration. Weights must be finite, nonnegative, match the source count, and have a positive sum; [param initial_duration] must be finite and positive. Members read the shared value directly without per-member writes. While configured, member overrides can be read with [method Object.get] but cannot be written individually. Graph property rebuilds rebind the group; if a member or source is missing, the whole group remains unbound until the paths are valid or reconfigured. Configuration is per tree, is not serialized, and must be restored by the caller when loading a scene. Must be called from the main thread; pending batch animation finishes before the configuration changes. Returns [code]false[/code] without changing the group if arguments are invalid.

method.name: set_blend_space_cycle_sync_weights
method.description: Updates the weights of the configured cycle sync sources. The same weight validation as [method configure_blend_space_cycle_sync] applies. Must be called from the main thread; pending batch animation finishes before weights change. Returns [code]false[/code] without changing weights if arguments are invalid.

method.name: set_parameter_group
method.description: Sets [param value] on every listed animation parameter property path. Each path uses the same format as an [AnimationTree] parameter property, such as [code]parameters/BlendSpace/blend_position[/code]. All paths and value types are checked before any value is changed. Integer-to-float and float-to-integer conversions follow [method Object.set]. Returns [code]false[/code] if a path does not exist, is read-only, or cannot accept [param value]. This method must be called from the main thread.

method.name: get_process_callback
method.description: Returns the process notification in which to update animations.

method.name: set_process_callback
method.description: Sets the process notification in which to update animations.

members.member: The path to the [Node] used to evaluate the [AnimationNode] [Expression] if one is not explicitly specified internally.
